title: Remarks at Woodville, Oregon
paragraphs: It is a great pleasure to see you and it is a great pleasure to be in Oregon. It has never been my good fortune to be in Oregon before. I know your people well and feel thoroughly at home here. I know Oregon's history, I know the men and women and what they have done, and I am as glad as I can be to be here to catch a glimpse of your great and beautiful state, and above all of the men and women.in it. I thank you for coming to greet me this evening. (Cheers and applause.)
